headline: State Bank of Pakistan foreign exchange reserves rose by $16 million to $21.469 billion in the week ended October 9; total liquid reserves $26.863 billion

card.desc: Total liquid reserves reached $26.863bn in the week ended October 9

caption:
The State Bank of Pakistan's foreign exchange reserves rose by $16 million to $21.469 billion in the week ended October 9, Dawn reported. Total liquid reserves reached $26.863 billion, including $5.393 billion held by commercial banks.
